name: Citrus aurantiifolia extract
description: Citrus aurantiifolia extract (CAS 90063-52-8 ), also sourced and referenced as Citrus aurantifolia flower extract, is a botanical extract derived from the lime plant. It delivers characteristic citrus flavor and fragrance profiles across food, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical formulations. In flavor manufacturing, it contributes authentic lime character to beverages, confectionery, and savory seasonings where natural citrus notes are required. Personal care formulators incorporate it into perfumes, skin care products, and hair care lines. The extract provides a fresh citrus scent and acts as a carrier for other active ingredients. In pharmaceutical and nutraceutical applications, it functions as a flavoring agent to mask unpleasant tastes in oral dosage forms and dietary supplements. Food producers also use it in marinades, dressings, and functional food products where a natural lime flavor designation supports clean-label positioning. This versatile ingredient is essential for creating high-quality consumer goods. Citrus aurantiifolia extract is typically supplied as a liquid extract, essential oil, or standardized oleoresin depending on the intended application. Grades available include food-grade and cosmetic-grade options for various industries. Food-grade material commonly meets FCC specifications to ensure safety and compliance. Packaging ranges from small quantities for specialty formulators to bulk drum supply for industrial buyers and large-scale manufacturing needs.
